# 凋零附魔

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1327308441324097681?label=discord&color=blue&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC) 
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/withering-enchantment?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/withering-enchantment) 
[![授權](https://img.shields.io/github/license/lullaby6/data-packs)](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

為劍新增的「凋零」附魔，可對目標施加凋零效果。

此附魔最高有2個等級，每個等級皆會增加效果持續時間。

可從附魔台、戰利品箱或與村民交易獲得。

## ⌨️ 指令

給予物品：

```mcfunction
/loot give @s loot withering_enchantment:withering_<等級>
```

附魔：

```mcfunction
/enchant @s withering_enchantment:withering <等級>
```

## 🪪 授權條款

[AGPL-3.0-or-later](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)
